integrity: The mathematical proof and finite verifier are included. Finite checks are not claimed as an infinite proof. Previous results on graph VC dimensions, domination, the exponential formula, and Poisson subgraph limits are credited.
scientific_limitations: The scope is edge sets induced by vertex subsets, not graph neighborhoods or connected edge ranges. The random limit concerns uniform fixed-size subsets of edges of a complete graph. The Poisson argument gives no explicit finite-size error estimate. Independent mathematical validation and priority review remain unperformed.
title: Shattered induced-edge traces: star forests, domination, and a sharp Poisson window
